# Pixel Mood Journal

An offline browser app to log your mood with an optional note. Pick one of five mood faces, write a note, and add an entry dated today. Entries are listed newest first, and mood counts are shown.

## Features

- 5 mood faces drawn with CSS (happy, sad, angry, anxious, calm)
- Optional note (up to 200 characters)
- Entries stored in `localStorage` (fallback to in-memory)
- Entries listed newest first with date and mood
- Mood counts summary
- Keyboard accessible: arrow keys to navigate moods, Enter/Space to select, Tab to move between controls
- Responsive layout from 360px wide
- No external assets or network requests

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Select a mood, optionally type a note, then click **Add Entry**. Your entries persist across reloads (if localStorage is available).

## Files

- `index.html` – main structure
- `styles.css` – styling
- `app.js` – logic and storage

## Build & Test

No build step required. Test by opening `index.html` directly. Verify keyboard navigation and that entries save correctly.
